reason: The plugin is primarily an external service integration that connects WeChat (Tencent ClawBot/iLink) with DeepSeek Harness, acting as a two-way communication bridge for agent-assisted message handling. Evidence shows core behavior is chat messaging transport plus WeChat-triggered session controls and agent notification/approval interactions, with local persistence of session and credential state.

summaries.zh: 这是一个微信 ClawBot 与 DSH 连接的消息桥插件，可将微信私聊内容同步到 DSH 会话并将 agent 回复回发到微信，支持会话切换和审批/通知类指令。
summaries.en: This is a WeChat ClawBot to DSH bridge plugin that routes private WeChat messages into DSH sessions and sends agent replies back to WeChat, with basic session controls and approval/notification commands.

capabilities: Bridges WeChat ClawBot messages to DeepSeek Harness and returns DSH replies to WeChat
Supports user/session commands for status and chat session switching
Provides allowlist/admin gating for who can interact with the bot
Persists session, credentials, cursor, and media metadata in plugin-local directories
Enables media handling for images, voice, files, and video attachments
Exposes outbound notification tools for agent-initiated pushes to WeChat
Includes an approval flow where agents can request user confirmation via WeChat commands

reasons.code: README states explicit WeChat ClawBot ↔ DSH bidirectional bridge and command set
Configuration references credentials, allowUsers/adminUsers, notifier, approval settings, and local persistence paths
Package declares a DSH bundle plugin with Cordis integration metadata and iLink-focused dependencies
